title: Rory and the Silver-Lit Meadow
verses:
The moon started rising above the dark trees,
As Psittaco chirped from a branch overhead.
He fluttered through leaves in the soft evening breeze,
To show them the path to a velvety bed.

Sweet Tilly stepped slowly through mosses so deep,
While Nia soared high on her velvety wings.
Big Benny sank down with a sigh full of sleep,
To listen to sounds that the night-river sings.

Then Rory, the gentle green T-Rex, stepped near,
And gathered soft fronds in a pile on the ground.
He smiled at his friends who were tucked in right here,
Where blossoms gave off a sweet slumbering sound.

Brave Ricky curled round with his chin on his paw,
His heavy scale armor as warm as a rug.
He gazed at the stars with a peaceful young awe,
While Nia flew down for a sleepy night hug.

Now Psittaco chirped as he wiggled inside
A cradle of leaves that was woven with care.
The fireflies danced in a silver-lit glide,
And drifted like dreams through the cool night-time air.

The valley grew quiet, the starlight burned low,
As bedtime crept in with a breath soft and deep.
The dinos were wrapped in a velvety glow,
And drifted away to a calm, gentle sleep.
